title: Research Interests
subtitle: My research explores the intersection of technology and human-centered design. Key areas of focus include:

items.title: Human-Computer Interaction
items.summary: Designing and evaluating novel interactive systems that are intuitive, efficient, and enjoyable to use.
items.description:
Here you can write a detailed explanation of your work in HCI.

This could include your design philosophy, specific methodologies you use (e.g., user-centered design, participatory design), and the ultimate goals of your HCI research.

items.title: Machine Learning
items.summary: Developing interpretable ML models and applying them to understand complex human behaviors and social phenomena.
items.description:
This is the space to elaborate on your machine learning research.

You could discuss the types of models you build (e.g., deep learning, reinforcement learning), your focus on interpretability and fairness, and specific application domains (e.g., healthcare, education).

items.title: Data Visualization
items.summary: Creating interactive visualizations that help people explore, understand, and communicate complex data.
items.description:
Expand on your data visualization work here.

Detail your work on information visualization (InfoVis) or scientific visualization (SciVis), the development of new visualization techniques, or your research on how visualizations impact human perception and decision-making.
